children: Dubai-based Al Ghurair Development said Tessera, its new residential project in Dubai South, is expected to be completed in 2028.
The project is designed by Portugal-based architect Manuel Aires Mateus as a low-density development, the company said in a statement.
The first phase includes two-bedroom-plus to three-bedroom-plus homes, including duplex residences. The company did not disclose the number of units or when construction will begin.
Al Ghurair has a presence across eight countries, building and managing more than 20,000 residential and commercial units, including nearly 1,000 hotel rooms and serviced units.
Its Dubai portfolio includes Weave in Jumeirah Village Circle, 46-storey Wedyan on Dubai Canal, an upcoming residential development in Wadi Al Safa 3 and a district-scale master plan in Al Jaddaf.
(Writing by P Deol; Editing by Anoop Menon)
